method info

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method info class
    messages = ,
    "ICU4ooRexxIsRegistered",,
    "maxCodepoint",,
    "systemIsLittleEndian",,
    "unicodeVersion",,
    "utf8procVersion"

    info = .StringTable~new
    do message over messages
        value = self~send(message)
        info~put(value, message)
    end

    return info

method stringInfo

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method stringInfo class
    if arg() == 2 then use strict arg string, >indexer
                  else use strict arg string
    string = requestBaseString(string)
    if arg() == 2 then indexer = .RexxUnicodeStringIndexer~new(string)              -- indexer requested by user: non-incremental with default limits
                  else indexer = .RexxUnicodeStringIndexer~new(string, 0, 0, 0)     -- no need to store indexes and errors
    return indexer~stringInfo

/*
NFKC preserves the original case of letters (e.g., 'A' remains 'A').
In contrast, NFKC_CF applies Unicode case-folding rules to map all characters to a case-insensitive form.
    Example: The German sharp s (ß) remains ß in NFKC but maps to ss in NFKC_CF.
    Example: The Greek final sigma (ς) maps to the standard sigma (σ) in NFKC_CF, whereas NFKC leaves it unchanged.
NFKC_CF is specifically optimized for identifier matching.
As part of the "Default Case Folding" algorithm, it removes ignorable characters (such as certain formatting marks or zero-width spaces).
NFKC retains these characters.
*/

method stringToNFKC_CF

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method stringToNFKC_CF class
    use strict arg string, lump= .false, nlf = 0, stripCC = .false, stripMark = .false, stripNA = .false
    string = requestBaseString(string)
    return self~utf8Transform(string, /*casefold*/ .true, lump, nlf, /*normalization*/ self~NFKC,  stripCC, /*stripIgnorable*/ .true, stripMark, stripNA)

method stringToNFKD

::class "RexxUnicode"

    use strict arg string, casefold = .false, lump= .false, nlf = 0, stripCC = .false, stripIgnorable= .false, stripMark = .false, stripNA = .false
    string = requestBaseString(string)
    return self~utf8Transform(string, casefold, lump, nlf, self~NFKD,  stripCC, stripIgnorable, stripMark, stripNA)


/*******************************************************************************
Additional codepoint services
*******************************************************************************/

-- Returns .true if codepoint is in the range 0...RexxUnicode~maxCodepoint
-- The range U+D800-U+DFFF is allowed (surrogates).
-- If minusOneAllowed is true then -1 is allowed (special value used in case of error).

method checkCodepoint

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method checkCodepoint class
    use strict arg codepoint, minusOneAllowed=.false
    if \ datatype(codepoint, "W") then signal not_wholenumber
    if codepoint == -1, minusOneAllowed then return .true
    if codepoint < 0 | codepoint > self~maxCodepoint then signal error_range
    return .true

    error_range:
    not_wholenumber: raise syntax 88.900 array ("Code point must be in the range 0 to" self~maxCodepoint "("self~D2U(self~maxCodepoint)"); found" quoted(codepoint))
    -- error_range: raise syntax 88.900 array ("Invalid code point:" codepoint"; allowed range is 0 to" self~maxCodepoint "("self~D2U(self~maxCodepoint)")")


-- Returns the UTF-8 encoding of this codepoint.

method codepointUTF8Encoding

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method codepointUTF8Encoding class
    use strict arg codepoint, buffer=.nil
    self~checkCodepoint(codepoint, /*minusOneAllowed*/ .true)
    returnBuffer = .nil <> buffer
    if .nil == buffer then buffer = .MutableBuffer~new
    if codepoint < 0 then nop -- the UTF-8 encoding is ""
    else self~utf8EncodeCodepoint(codepoint, buffer)
    if returnBuffer then return buffer
    return buffer~string


-- Unicode standard name, can be ""

method codepointCharName

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method codepointCharName class
    use strict arg codepoint, raiseError=.false
    self~checkCodepoint(codepoint, /*minusOneAllowed*/ .true)
    if codepoint < 0 then return ""
    name = ""
    if self~assertICU4ooRexxIsRegistered(raiseError) then do
        name = .ICU4ooRexx~u_charName(codepoint)
    end
    return name

/*******************************************************************************
Codepoint from identifier
*******************************************************************************/

-- Gets a codepoint from a character name.
-- Private helper for .RexxUnicodeServices~utf8StringUnescape, .RexxUnicode~stringUnescape and .RexxUnicode~codepoint.
-- The native utf8StringUnescape method cannot call a private method when the native method is called outside an ooRexx method context.
-- Workaround: Call the native utf8StringUnescape method from an ooRexx method of RexxUnicode.

method codepointFromName

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method codepointFromName class private
    use strict arg name
    name = requestBaseString(name, "name")

    codepoint = -1
    if self~ICU4ooRexxIsRegistered, self~stringIsASCII(name) then do
        -- Keep this cascade of search, even if h_charFromLooseName is supposed to cover all possible cases.
        -- Counterexamples where h_charFromLooseName fails to find the codepoint
        -- but h_charFromExtendedName succeeds:
        --   say .RexxUnicode~character("<control-000>")    -- (<?> \x{00} U+0000 Cc Control "<control-0000>")
        --   say .RexxUnicode~character("<control-00>")     -- (<?> \x{00} U+0000 Cc Control "<control-0000>")
        --   say .RexxUnicode~character("<control-0>")      -- (<?> \x{00} U+0000 Cc Control "<control-0000>")
        codepoint = .ICU4ooRexx~h_charFromExtendedName(name) -- The extended name space includes the standard name space
        if codepoint == -1 then codepoint = .ICU4ooRexx~h_charFromNameAlias(name)
        if codepoint == -1 then codepoint = .ICU4ooRexx~h_charFromLooseName(name)
    end
    return codepoint


/*
Gets a codepoint from a codepoint identifier.
A codepoint identifier may be:
- a decimal value (the codepoint itself),
- a U+ notation,
- a character name,
- or a UTF-8 encoded character.
*/

method codepoint

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method codepoint class
    use strict arg identifier
    identifier = requestBaseString(identifier, "identifier")

    -- is identifier a decimal codepoint ?
    if datatype(identifier, "W") then do
        codepoint = identifier
        self~checkCodepoint(codepoint, /*minusOneAllowed*/ .true)
        return codepoint
    end

    -- is identifier a U+ codepoint ?
    if identifier~caselessStartsWith("U+") then do
        codepoint = self~U2D(identifier, /*start*/ 1, /*raiseError*/ .true)
        self~checkCodepoint(codepoint, /*minusOneAllowed*/ .true)
        return codepoint
    end

    -- is identifier a character name?
    codepoint = self~codepointFromName(identifier)
    if codepoint \== -1 then return codepoint

    -- fallback: if the identifier is made of just one codepoint then return this codepoint
    indexer = .RexxUnicodeStringIndexer~new(identifier, /*startGraphemeStorageLimit:*/ 0, /*startCodepointStorageLimit:*/ 1, /*startErrorStorageLimit:*/ 0)
    if indexer~codepointCount == 1 then return indexer~codepointAtIndexC(1)

    additional = ""
    if \ self~ICU4ooRexxIsRegistered then additional = " (ICU4ooRexx not loaded)"
    raise syntax 98.900 array("Name" quoted(identifier) "not found" || additional)


-- Gets a RexxUnicodeCharacter from a codepoint identifier.
-- See the `codepoint` method for a definition of "codepoint identifier".

method character

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method character class
    use strict arg identifier
    identifier = requestBaseString(identifier, "identifier")
    codepoint = self~codepoint(identifier)
    return .RexxUnicodeCharacter~new(codepoint)


/*******************************************************************************
Loose matching
*******************************************************************************/

/*
UAX44-LM2.
https://unicode.org/reports/tr44/#UAX44-LM2
*/

method UAX44_LM2

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method UAX44_LM2 class
    use strict arg name
    name = requestBaseString(name, "name")
    if \ self~stringIsASCII(name) then raise syntax 22.900 array("Name must be an ASCII string; found" quoted(name))
    buffer = .MutableBuffer~new(name)
    /*
    1. remove all medial hyphens (except the medial hyphen in the name for U+1180
    HANGUL JUNGSEONG O-E).
    In this rule "medial hyphen" is to be construed as a hyphen occurring immediately
    between two letters in the normative Unicode character name, as published in
    the Unicode names list, and not to any hyphen that may transiently occur medially
    as a result of removing whitespace before removing hyphens in a particular
    implementation of matching.
    Thus the hyphen in the name U+10089 LINEAR B IDEOGRAM B107M HE-GOAT is medial,
    and should be ignored in loose matching,
    but the hyphen in the name U+0F39 TIBETAN MARK TSA -PHRU is not medial, and
    should not be ignored in loose matching.
    */
    buffer~space
    pos = 2 -- yes, 2, not 1
    do forever
        pos = buffer~verify("-", "M", pos)
        if pos == 0 then leave
        if buffer~subchar(pos-1)~verify(.string~alpha) == 0, buffer~subchar(pos+1)~verify(.string~alpha) == 0 then do
            if buffer~subchar(pos+2) == "", buffer~string~caselessEquals("HANGUL JUNGSEONG O-E") then leave
            buffer~replaceAt(" ", pos, 1)
        end
        else pos += 1 -- keep the hyphen. Ex: "TIBETAN MARK GTER YIG MGO -UM RNAM BCAD MA"
    end

    /*
    2. remove all whitespace and underscore characters
    */
    buffer~translate("", "_")
    buffer~space(0)

    /*
    3.apply toLowercase() to both strings
    */
    buffer~lower

    return buffer~string


/*
UAX44_LM2 also available as a native method on ICU4ooRexx (faster):
.ICU4ooRexx~h_UAX44_LM2
*/

method h_UAX44_LM2

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method h_UAX44_LM2 class
    use strict arg name
    name = requestBaseString(name, "name")
    if self~ICU4ooRexxIsRegistered then forward to .ICU4ooRexx
    forward message "UAX44_LM2"


/*
UAX44-LM3
https://unicode.org/reports/tr44/#UAX44-LM3
*/

method UAX44_LM3

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method UAX44_LM3 class
    use strict arg name
    name = requestBaseString(name, "name")
    if \ self~stringIsASCII(name) then raise syntax 22.900 array("Name must be an ASCII string; found" quoted(name))
    buffer = .MutableBuffer~new(name)
    /*
    Ignore case, whitespace, underscore ('_'), hyphens, and any initial prefix string "is".

    "linebreak" is equivalent to "Line_Break" or "Line-break"
    "lb=BA" is equivalent to "lb=ba" or "LB=BA"
    "Script=Greek" is equivalent to "Script=isGreek" or "Script=Is_Greek"
    */
    buffer~translate("", "_-")
    buffer~space(0)
    buffer~lower
    if buffer~pos("is", 1, 2) == 1 then buffer~delete(1, 2)
    return buffer~string


/*******************************************************************************
Escape characters
*******************************************************************************/

/*
Supported escape characters:
    \N{Unicode name}    Character name in the Unicode database
    \u{X..X}            Unicode scalar value, 1-8 hex digits
    \uXXXX              Unicode scalar value, exactly 4 hex digits
    \UXXXXXXXX          Unicode scalar value, exactly 8 hex digits
    \x{X..X}            Arbitrary number of hex digits
    \xXX                1 byte, exactly 2 hex digits

How other languages are supporting escape characters for Unicode:
    \N{Unicode name}    Character name in the Unicode database (Python, Perl, C++23)
    \o{X..X}            Arbitrary number of octal digits (C++23)
    \u{nnnn ...}        One or more Unicode characters, each 1–6 hex digits, space-separated (Ruby)
    \u{X..X}            Unicode scalar value, 1-8 hex digits (C++23, Swift)
    \u{X..X}            Unicode scalar value, 1–6 hex digits (Rust)
    \u{X..X}            Unicode scalar value, 1+ hex digits (beyond \uFFFF) (JavaScript (ES2015+))
    \u{X..X}            hexadecimal Unicode scalar value UTF-8 encoded (1 or more digits) (Zig, PHP 7+)
    \uXXXX              Unicode scalar value, exactly 4 hex digits (C, C++, C#, D, Go, Java, JavaScript, JSON, Julia, Netrexx, Python, Ruby)
    \UXXXXXXXX          Unicode scalar value, exactly 8 hex digits (C, C++, C#, D, Go, Julia, Python)
    \x{X..X}            Arbitrary number of hex digits (C++23, Perl)
    \xXX                1 byte, exactly 2 hex digits (D, Go, JavaScript, Netrexx, Python, Ruby, Zig)
    \xXX                1 byte, exactly 2 hex digits, ASCII range only (0x00–0x7F) (Rust)
    \xX..X              Variable-length hex digits (1–4) (C#)
    \NNN                Character/byte denoted by up to 3 octal digits (terminates early at first non-octal digit) (C, C++, D, Go, Python, Ruby)

    No language lets you write U+XXXX (conventionally 4–6 hex digits) inside a string literal;
    each one wraps that same numeric value in its own escape grammar instead (\u{1F600}, \U0001F600, etc.).

*/

-- Escape characters are normally handled in string literals at parse time.
-- This method handles them at run time instead.
-- Keep this method!
-- It calls the method .RexxUnicodeServices~utf8StringUnescape from the right context,
-- avoiding this error:
-- Object "The RexxUnicode class" cannot accept private message "CODEPOINTFROMNAME" from this context.

method utf8StringUnescape

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method utf8StringUnescape class
    forward class (super) -- inherited native method


-- Escape characters are normally handled in string literals at parse time.
-- This method handles them at run time instead.
-- This method is kept for compatibility with older versions of `rxunicode.cls`.

method stringUnescape

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method stringUnescape class
    forward class (super) message "utf8StringUnescape" -- inherited native method


-- This method is kept for compatibility with older versions of `rxunicode.cls`.

method stringEscape

::class "RexxUnicode"
::method stringEscape class
    forward message "utf8StringEscape" -- inherited native method

class "MessageDisplayer"

::class "MessageDisplayer" public
/******************************************************************************/

/*
Helper class that displays received messages.
The class itself or an instance of the class can be used as an observer.
Depends on .ooRexxShell.

Used for regression tests.
*/

method unknown

::class "MessageDisplayer"
::method unknown class
    .traceOutput~say("name=" quoted(arg(1)) "arguments=" .ooRexxShell~prettyString(arg(2)))

method unknown

::class "MessageDisplayer"
::method unknown
    .traceOutput~say("name=" quoted(arg(1)) "arguments=" .ooRexxShell~prettyString(arg(2)))


/*
Define a helper routine that displays the indexes and items of a supplier.
Can't use supplier== because pretty-printing the supplier creates a copy of the supplier,
and the copy is forbidden when an observer is assigned.

Used for regression tests.
*/

routine saySupplier

::routine saySupplier public
    use strict arg s
    do while s~available
        say s~index ":" s~item
        s~next
    end


/******************************************************************************/

class "CodepointSupplierHelper"

::class "CodepointSupplierHelper" private mixinclass Supplier
/******************************************************************************/

method getIndexType

::class "CodepointSupplierHelper"
::method getIndexType class private
    use strict arg type
    if type == "" then return ""
    if type~caselessMatchChar(1, "B") then return type~left(1)~lower
    raise syntax 88.900 array ("Expected an empty index type or one starting with 'B'; found" quoted(type))

method getItemType

::class "CodepointSupplierHelper"
::method getItemType class private
    use strict arg type
    if type~isa(.Class) then return type
    if type == "" then return ""

    raise syntax 88.900 array ("Expected an empty item type or one starting with 'B', 'E', 'U', 'X', or '\', or a Class object; found" quoted(type))

    Possible values:
    - "" to return the codepoint as a whole number (default)
    - "b" to return the codepoint byte sequence as a string
    - "e" to return the error message or ""
    - "u" to return the codepoint in U+ notation
    - "x" to return the codepoint byte sequence as hexadecimal digits
    - "\" to return the codepoint byte sequence as an escaped string

    use strict arg type=(defaultItemType)

        if type == "b" then return self~byteSequence -- YES! ALWAYS return the raw byte sequence

        if type == "u" then return .RexxUnicode~D2U(self~codepoint)
        if type == "x" then return escapedHexdigits(self~byteSequence~c2x)
        if type == "\" then return .RexxUnicode~stringEscape(self~byteSequence)
        if type~isa(.Class) then return type~new(self~codepoint)

    if index < self~indexC then raise syntax 88.900 array ("Invalid code point index:" index "is less than the current index" self~indexC "(the supplier can only advance)")
    loop while self~indexC \== index
        self~next
    end
    return self~item

    expose string indexB indexC -
           observer codepointAction

                   observer=.nil, -

                   indexB=1, -              -- Initial byte index (1-based): the first codepoint to decode starts at this index.

method decode

::class "RexxUnicodeCodepointSupplier"
::method decode private
    expose string indexB codepoint byteSequence error -
           observer codepointAction
    use strict arg -- none
    error = ""
    codepoint = .RexxUnicode~utf8DecodeCodepoint(string, indexB, >sizeB, >errorCode, >errorMsg)
    if sizeB == 0 then do
        codepoint = .nil -- end of string
        byteSequence = ""
    end
    else do

            error = "start byte position" indexB ":" errorMsg
            codepoint = "FFFD"~x2d -- the current byte sequence is invalid, return the replacement character

        byteSequence = string~substr(abs(indexB), abs(sizeB))
        if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction then observer~send(codepointAction, sizeB < 0, abs(indexB), abs(sizeB), codepoint, error)
    end

::method next
    expose indexB indexC byteSequence
    use strict arg -- none

        indexB = abs(indexB)
        indexB += byteSequence~length
        indexC += 1
        self~decode
    end
    else raise syntax 93.937 -- No more supplier items available

-- Using a mixin class requires giving access to these (normally) private variables.

attribute error

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::attribute error get package           -- "" if no error, otherwise error description

attribute grapheme

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::attribute grapheme get package        -- a string of length 1..n, or .nil if no more grapheme available

attribute graphemeIndexB

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::attribute graphemeIndexB get package  -- 1..length+1, counted from the beginning of the string, negative if the grapheme byte sequence is invalid

attribute indexG

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::attribute indexG get package          -- 1-based, counted from the beginning of the string

method init

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::method init
    expose isFirstStep string indexB indexG -
           observer graphemeAction codepointAction -
           verbose

    use strict arg string, defaultIndexType="", defaultItemType="", -
                   observer=.nil, -
                   graphemeAction=.nil, -       -- Message sent for each decoded grapheme.
                   codepointAction=.nil, -      -- Message sent for each decoded codepoint.
                   indexB=1, -                  -- Initial byte index (1-based): the first grapheme to decode starts at this index.
                   indexG=1, -                  -- Grapheme count from the begining of the string. Initial value corresponding to the initial byte position.
                   verbose=.false
    string = requestBaseString(string, "string")
    self~setDefaultIndexType(defaultIndexType)
    self~setDefaultItemType(defaultItemType)

    empty = .array~new(0) -- No need to create a copy, the string is immutable
    self~init:super(empty, empty)

    isFirstStep = .true
    self~decode

method copy

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::method copy
    expose observer
    use strict arg -- none
    -- 93.970 COPY method is not supported for object object.
    if .nil \== observer then raise syntax 93.900 array ("COPY method is not supported for object" self "when an observer is assigned")
    return self~copy:super


/*
This method is called from ~init and from ~next.

Simplification by Claude.
Key simplification versus the original: a grapheme is delimited by two
boundaries (its start and its end/next-start), and each call to ~decode only
ever needs to resolve ONE boundary before it can return - the other boundary
is always already known (either from the previous call, or, for the very
first grapheme, from the first step phase below). So there's no need for a
rotating 2-slot buffer: a single "pendingIndexB/pendingError" slot, filled by
the shared scanBoundary helper, is enough. ~next simply promotes that pending
boundary into graphemeIndexB/error before resuming here.

"Locate the start of grapheme 1" and "locate the end of the current grapheme"
are the same operation - scanBoundary is used for both.
*/

method decode

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::method decode private
    expose isFirstStep string grapheme graphemeIndexB error -
           /* scan state, shared with scanBoundary */ -
           indexB previousCodepoint graphemeBreakState pendingIndexB pendingError -
           observer graphemeAction

    use strict arg -- none

    if isFirstStep then do
        previousCodepoint = -1
        graphemeBreakState = 0
        self~scanBoundary                  -- locates the start of the first grapheme (.nil if the string is empty)
        graphemeIndexB = pendingIndexB
        error = pendingError
        isFirstStep = .false
    end

    if graphemeIndexB~isNil then do    -- nothing left to deliver (empty string, or already exhausted)
        grapheme = .nil
        return                         -- grapheme ready for use (.nil): ~available will now report .false
    end

    self~scanBoundary                  -- locates the end of the current grapheme (.nil at end of string)
    if pendingIndexB~isNil then grapheme = string~substr(abs(graphemeIndexB))
    else grapheme = string~substr(abs(graphemeIndexB), abs(pendingIndexB) - abs(graphemeIndexB))
    if .nil \== observer, .nil \== graphemeAction then observer~send(graphemeAction, error \== "", abs(graphemeIndexB), grapheme~length, error)
    -- grapheme, graphemeIndexB and error are ready for use;
    -- on reentry from ~next, graphemeIndexB/error have been set from pendingIndexB/pendingError
    return


-- Advances indexB (decoding codepoints one at a time, tracking previousCodepoint
-- and graphemeBreakState for the extended grapheme break algorithm) until either
-- a grapheme boundary is found or the string is exhausted.
-- Result is left in pendingIndexB/pendingError:
--   pendingIndexB = .nil                     -> end of string, nothing more to scan
--   pendingIndexB = byte position (>0)       -> boundary at a validly-decoded codepoint
--   pendingIndexB = -(byte position)         -> boundary at an invalid byte sequence; pendingError describes it

method scanBoundary

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::method scanBoundary private
    expose string indexB previousCodepoint graphemeBreakState pendingIndexB pendingError -
           observer codepointAction -
           verbose

    use strict arg -- none

    loop forever
        codepoint = .RexxUnicode~utf8DecodeCodepoint(string, indexB, >sizeB, >errorCode, >errorMsg)

        if sizeB == 0 then do                  -- end of string
            pendingIndexB = .nil
            pendingError  = ""
            return
        end

        if sizeB < 0 then do                   -- invalid byte sequence: always its own boundary
            pendingIndexB = -indexB
            pendingError  = "start byte position" indexB ":" errorMsg
            if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction then observer~send(codepointAction, .true, indexB, -sizeB, codepoint, pendingError)
            indexB += abs(sizeB)                -- skip the invalid bytes
            previousCodepoint = codepoint
            graphemeBreakState = 0              -- reset the extended grapheme state
            return
        end
        else do
            if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction then observer~send(codepointAction, .false, indexB, sizeB, codepoint, "")
        end

        -- graphemeBreak must NOT be called when previousCodepoint < 0 (nothing to compare against yet)
        if previousCodepoint < 0 then isBoundary = 1
        else do
            isBoundary = .RexxUnicode~graphemeBreak(previousCodepoint, codepoint, >graphemeBreakState)
            if verbose then say "    graphemeBreak with previousCodepoint =" previousCodepoint", codepoint =" codepoint "returned" isBoundary
        end

        boundaryHere = indexB
        previousCodepoint = codepoint
        indexB += sizeB

        if isBoundary then do
            pendingIndexB = boundaryHere
            pendingError  = ""
            return
        end
        -- else: no break here, keep scanning (loop continues)
    end

method next

::class "RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier"
::method next
    expose error indexG graphemeIndexB pendingIndexB pendingError

    use strict arg -- none
    if self~available then do
        indexG += 1
        graphemeIndexB = pendingIndexB
        error = pendingError
        self~decode
    end
    else raise syntax 93.937 -- No more supplier items available

::attribute error get package           -- "" if no error, otherwise error description

method init

::class "RexxUnicodeReverseGraphemeSupplier"
::method init
    expose string indexB indexG error -
           observer graphemeAction codepointAction -
           notifyNextCodepoint -
           verbose

    -- indexB boundary (1-based): the grapheme to decode ends just before this
    -- indexG count from the end of the string
    use strict arg string, defaultIndexType="", defaultItemType="", -
                   observer=.nil, -
                   graphemeAction=.nil, -           -- Message sent for each decoded grapheme.
                   codepointAction=.nil, -          -- Message sent for each decoded codepoint.
                   indexB=(string~length + 1), -    -- Initial byte index (1-based): the first grapheme to decode ends just before this index.
                   indexG=1, -                      -- Grapheme count from the end of the string. Initial value corresponding to the initial byte position.
                   verbose=.false
    string = requestBaseString(string, "string")
    self~setDefaultIndexType(defaultIndexType)
    self~setDefaultItemType(defaultItemType)

    empty = .array~new(0) -- No need to create a copy, the string is immutable
    self~init:super(empty, empty)

    notifyNextCodepoint = .true -- will be set to .false where appropriate to avoid duplicate notifications

    -- Unlike the reverse codepoint supplier, I don't use a variable named "boundaryIndexB".
    -- "indexB" can be used, because the grapheme byte position is managed with "graphemeIndexB".
    error = ""
    self~decodePrevious

method copy

::class "RexxUnicodeReverseGraphemeSupplier"
::method copy
    expose observer
    use strict arg -- none
    -- 93.970 COPY method is not supported for object object.
    if .nil \== observer then raise syntax 93.900 array ("COPY method is not supported for object" self "when an observer is assigned")
    return self~copy:super

method next

::class "RexxUnicodeReverseGraphemeSupplier"
::method next
    expose indexB indexG graphemeIndexB
    use strict arg -- none
    if self~available then do
        indexB = abs(graphemeIndexB)   -- move the right edge to the grapheme we just found
        indexG += 1
        self~decodePrevious
    end
    else raise syntax 93.937 -- No more supplier items available


-- Decode the grapheme cluster ending immediately before `indexB`, and set
-- indexB's new left edge into graphemeIndexB. grapheme = .nil at start of text.

method decodePrevious

::class "RexxUnicodeReverseGraphemeSupplier"
::method decodePrevious private
    expose string indexB grapheme graphemeIndexB error -
           observer graphemeAction codepointAction -
           notifyNextCodepoint -
           verbose

    use strict arg -- none

    error = ""

    -- ok, it's an alternative way to detect the beginning of string,
    -- the other way being to test if sizeB == 0 after utf8DecodePreviousCodepoint.
    if indexB <= 1 then do
        grapheme = .nil
        graphemeIndexB = .nil
        return
    end

    -- here, indexB is the index of the codepoint AFTER the codepoint to decode
    codepoint2 = .RexxUnicode~utf8DecodePreviousCodepoint(string, indexB, >sizeB, >errorCode, >errorMsg)
    cursor = indexB - abs(sizeB)      -- start of the rightmost scalar so far

    -- An ill-formed byte's maximal subpart is always its own grapheme cluster
    -- (mirrors the forward supplier's error handling: no merging across an error).
    if sizeB < 0 then do
        graphemeIndexB = -cursor -- same convention as .RexxUnicodeStringIndexer; a negative byte index indicates an invalid byte sequence
        grapheme = string~substr(cursor, indexB - cursor)
        error = "start byte position" cursor ":" errorMsg
        -- if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction, notifyNextCodepoint then observer~send(codepointAction, .true, cursor, -sizeB, codepoint2, error)
        if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction  then do
            if notifyNextCodepoint then observer~send(codepointAction, .true, cursor, -sizeB, codepoint2, error)
            else if verbose then say "*** I don't notify "  ||codepointAction || "(.true, " || cursor || ", "||  -sizeB || ", "codepoint2 || ")"
        end
        notifyNextCodepoint = .true -- reset to default value
        if .nil \== observer, .nil \== graphemeAction then observer~send(graphemeAction, .true, cursor, grapheme~length, error)
        return
    end
    else do
        -- if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction, notifyNextCodepoint then observer~send(codepointAction, .false, cursor, sizeB, codepoint2, "")
        if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction then do
            if notifyNextCodepoint then observer~send(codepointAction, .false, cursor, sizeB, codepoint2, "")
            else if verbose then say "*** I don't notify "  ||codepointAction || "(.true, " || cursor || ", "||  sizeB || ", "codepoint2 || ")"
        end
        notifyNextCodepoint = .true -- reset to default value
    end

    loop
        if cursor <= 1 then leave    -- start of text: always a boundary

        -- here, cursor is the index of the codepoint AFTER the codepoint to decode
        codepoint1 = .RexxUnicode~utf8DecodePreviousCodepoint(string, cursor, >sizeB1, >errorCode1, >errorMsg1)
        pos1 = cursor - abs(sizeB1)

         -- Notify now, to be aligned with the forward grapheme supplier.
        -- The codepoint notifications are always before the closed grapheme notification.
       if sizeB1 < 0 then do
            error = "start byte position" pos1 ":" errorMsg1
            if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction then observer~send(codepointAction, .true, pos1, -sizeB1, codepoint1, error)
        end
        else do
            if .nil \== observer, .nil \== codepointAction then observer~send(codepointAction, .false, pos1, sizeB1, codepoint1, "")
        end

        if sizeB1 < 0 then do
            notifyNextCodepoint = .false -- because it will be this codepoint, already notified
            leave    -- adjacent error is always its own cluster: break here
        end

        graphemeBreakBackward = .RexxUnicode~graphemeBreakBackward(string, pos1, codepoint1, codepoint2)
        if verbose then say "    graphemeBreakBackward with pos1 =" pos1", codepoint1 =" codepoint1", codepoint2 =" codepoint2 "returned" graphemeBreakBackward
        if graphemeBreakBackward then do
            notifyNextCodepoint = .false -- because it will be this codepoint, already notified
            leave
        end

        -- No break: extend the grapheme leftward and keep going
        cursor = pos1
        codepoint2 = codepoint1
        prop2 = prop1
    end

    graphemeIndexB = cursor
    grapheme = string~substr(cursor, indexB - cursor)
    error = ""
    if .nil \== observer, .nil \== graphemeAction then observer~send(graphemeAction, .false, cursor, grapheme~length, "")

class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer" public
/******************************************************************************/

/*
Direct access to codepoints and graphemes.
This is a temporary implementation, to be replaced by a native indexer.

The memory usage of the native grapheme indexer will be roughly 15% of the string size (12.5% for a bit vector and 2.5% for a two-level summary table).
Same memory usage for the native codepoint indexer.
The memory usage of the invalid byte flags will be between 0% and 12.5% of the string size (bit vector).
*/

method new

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method new class
    use strict arg string, -
                   startGraphemeStorageLimit = (.RexxInfo~internalMaxNumber), startCodepointStorageLimit = (.RexxInfo~internalMaxNumber), startErrorStorageLimit = (.RexxInfo~internalMaxNumber), -
                   endGraphemeStorageLimit = 0, endCodepointStorageLimit = 0, endErrorStorageLimit = 0, -
                   verbose = .false, trace = ""

    .Validate~classType("string", string, .string)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("startGraphemeStorageLimit", startGraphemeStorageLimit, 18)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("startCodepointStorageLimit", startCodepointStorageLimit, 18)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("startErrorStorageLimit", startErrorStorageLimit, 18)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("endGraphemeStorageLimit", endGraphemeStorageLimit, 18)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("endCodepointStorageLimit", endCodepointStorageLimit, 18)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("endErrorStorageLimit", endErrorStorageLimit, 18)
    .Validate~logical("verbose", verbose)
    .Validate~classType("trace", trace, .string)

    -- Pass incremental = .false
    self~new:super(string, -
                   startGraphemeStorageLimit, startCodepointStorageLimit, startErrorStorageLimit, -
                   endGraphemeStorageLimit, endCodepointStorageLimit, endErrorStorageLimit, -
                   /*incremental:*/ .false, verbose, trace)
    return result

                   endGraphemeStorageAdjustableLimit = 0, endCodepointStorageAdjustableLimit = 0, endErrorStorage = .false, -
                   verbose = .false, trace = ""

    .Validate~classType("string", string, .string)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("startGraphemeStorageAdjustableLimit", startGraphemeStorageAdjustableLimit, 18)
    .Validate~nonNegativeWholeNumber("startCodepointStorageAdjustableLimit", startCodepointStorageAdjustableLimit, 18)

    .Validate~logical("verbose", verbose)
    .Validate~classType("trace", trace, .string)

    -- Pass incremental = .true
    self~new:super(string, -
                   startGraphemeStorageAdjustableLimit, startCodepointStorageAdjustableLimit, startErrorStorage, -
                   endGraphemeStorageAdjustableLimit, endCodepointStorageAdjustableLimit, endErrorStorage, -
                   /*incremental:*/ .true, verbose, trace)
    return result

method init

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method init
    expose string -
           startCodepointStorageLimit startGraphemeStorageLimit startErrorStorageLimit -
           endCodepointStorageLimit endGraphemeStorageLimit endErrorStorageLimit -
           startCodepointIndexes endCodepointIndexes -
           codepointCount -
           startGraphemeIndexes startLastGraphemeNextIndexB endGraphemeIndexes -
           graphemeCount -
           startErrorMessages endErrorMessages -
           errorCount -
           incremental verbose trace-
           -    -- Fix gaps and duplicates in incremental mode, by Claude Sonnet 5 medium
           startNextCodepointB endNextCodepointEndB -
           startCodepointErrorCount startGraphemeErrorCount -
           endCodepointErrorCount endGraphemeErrorCount

    -- The default values are defined by ~new and ~newIncremental.
    -- In incremental mode, startErrorStorageLimit and endErrorStorageLimit is boolean-ish:
    -- 0 is .false, and any non-zero value is .true; the actual value is ignored.
    use strict arg string, -
                   startGraphemeStorageLimit, startCodepointStorageLimit, startErrorStorageLimit, -
                   endGraphemeStorageLimit, endCodepointStorageLimit, endErrorStorageLimit, -
                   incremental, verbose, trace
    trace value trace -- retro trace not possible here
    string = requestBaseString(string)

    codepointCount = 0
    graphemeCount = 0
    errorCount = 0

    startCodepointIndexes = .nil
    startGraphemeIndexes = .nil
    startErrorMessages = .nil

    -- Extra index to let calculate the grapheme's length of the grapheme at startGraphemeStorageLimit.
    -- This index is not put in startGraphemeIndexes to keep startGraphemeIndexes's items <= startGraphemeStorageLimit.
    startLastGraphemeNextIndexB = string~length + 1 -- will be updated during the scan

    -- Used to fix gaps and duplicates in incremental mode
    startNextCodepointB = 1
    endNextCodepointEndB = string~length + 1
    startCodepointErrorCount = 0    -- errors inside the stored start codepoints
    startGraphemeErrorCount = 0     -- errors inside the stored start graphemes
    endCodepointErrorCount = 0      -- errors inside the stored end codepoints
    endGraphemeErrorCount = 0       -- errors inside the stored end graphemes

    /*
    Remember:
    - no need of endLastGraphemeNextIndex for endGraphemeIndexes
      because it's always string~length + 1.
    - no need of startLastCodepointNextIndex for startCodepointIndexes
      because the UTF-8 encoding gives the length (the codepoint is decoded to return it as a wholenumber).
    - no need of endLastCodepointNextIndex for endCodepointIndexes, for the same reason.
    */

    endCodepointIndexes = .nil
    endGraphemeIndexes = .nil
    endErrorMessages = .nil

    /***************************/
    /* Fast path if no storage */
    /***************************/

    if startCodepointStorageLimit == 0, startGraphemeStorageLimit == 0, startErrorStorageLimit == 0, -
       endCodepointStorageLimit == 0, endGraphemeStorageLimit == 0, endErrorStorageLimit == 0 -
    then do
        -- No storage, fast path
        .RexxUnicodeServices~utf8StringInfo(string, >graphemeCount, >codepointCount, >errorCount)
        return
    end

    /**********************/
    /* Forward indexation */
    /**********************/

    if verbose then do
        if startCodepointStorageLimit > 0 then startCodepointIndexes = .VerboseArray~new("startCodepointIndexes", 0)
        if startGraphemeStorageLimit > 0 then startGraphemeIndexes = .VerboseArray~new("startGraphemeIndexes", 0)
        if startErrorStorageLimit > 0 then startErrorMessages = .VerboseArray~new("startErrorMessages", 0)
    end
    else do
        if startCodepointStorageLimit > 0 then startCodepointIndexes = .array~new(0)
        if startGraphemeStorageLimit > 0 then startGraphemeIndexes = .array~new(0)
        if startErrorStorageLimit > 0 then startErrorMessages = .array~new(0)
    end

    -- Must always use a grapheme supplier, even if the grapheme storage is disabled, to count the graphemes.
    self~startStoragesClearUpdatedFlags
    if verbose then do
        say
        say "******************** init - Initialization Forward Grapheme Supplier"
        say
    end
    s = .RexxUnicodeGraphemeSupplier~new(string, , , -
                                         self, "startGraphemeInitializationAction", "startCodepointInitializationAction", -
                                         , , verbose)
    do while s~available
        if incremental then do
            self~startStoragesAdjustLimits
            self~startStoragesClearUpdatedFlags
        end
        -- full scan
        if verbose then do
            say
            say "******************** init - Initialization Forward Grapheme Supplier"
            say
        end
        s~next
    end

    /***********************/
    /* Backward indexation */
    /***********************/

    startItems = 0
    if .nil \== startCodepointIndexes then startItems = startCodepointIndexes~items
    endCodepointStorageLimit = min(endCodepointStorageLimit, codepointCount - startItems)
    if endCodepointStorageLimit > 0 then do
        if verbose then endCodepointIndexes = .VerboseArray~new("endCodepointIndexes", 0 /*endCodepointStorageLimit*/)
                   else endCodepointIndexes = .array~new(0 /*endCodepointStorageLimit*/)
    end

    startItems = 0
    if .nil \== startGraphemeIndexes then startItems = startGraphemeIndexes~items
    endGraphemeStorageLimit = min(endGraphemeStorageLimit, graphemeCount - startItems)
    if endGraphemeStorageLimit > 0 then do
        if verbose then endGraphemeIndexes = .VerboseArray~new("endGraphemeIndexes", 0 /*endGraphemeStorageLimit*/)
                   else endGraphemeIndexes = .array~new(0 /*endGraphemeStorageLimit*/)
    end

    startItems = 0
    if .nil \== startErrorMessages then startItems = startErrorMessages~items
    if incremental then do
        -- boolean-ish
        if startItems == errorCount then endErrorStorageLimit = .false -- all errors already stored
    end
    else do
        -- real limit
        endErrorStorageLimit = min(endErrorStorageLimit, errorCount - startItems)
    end
    if endErrorStorageLimit > 0 then do -- if .true or positive
        if verbose then endErrorMessages = .VerboseArray~new("endErrorMessages", 0 /*endErrorStorageLimit*/)
                   else endErrorMessages = .array~new(0 /*endErrorStorageLimit*/)
    end

    -- Use a reverse codepoint supplier when the end grapheme storage is disabled.
    if .nil == endGraphemeIndexes then do
        self~endStoragesClearUpdatedFlags
        if verbose then do
            say
            say "******************** init - Initialization Backward Codepoint Supplier"
            say
        end
        s = .RexxUnicodeReverseCodepointSupplier~new(string, , , -
                                                    self, "endCodepointInitializationAction", -
                                                    , )
        do while s~available
            -- stop when all end storages are full
            if self~endStoragesLimitsReached then leave
            if incremental then do
                self~endStoragesAdjustLimits
                self~endStoragesClearUpdatedFlags
            end

            if verbose then do
                say
                say "******************** init - Initialization Backward Codepoint Supplier"
                say
            end
            s~next
        end
    end
    else do
        self~endStoragesClearUpdatedFlags
        if verbose then do
            say
            say "******************** init - Initialization Backward Grapheme Supplier"
            say
        end
        s = .RexxUnicodeReverseGraphemeSupplier~new(string, , , -
                                                    self, "endGraphemeInitializationAction", "endCodepointInitializationAction", -
                                                    , , verbose)
        do while s~available
            -- stop when all end storages are full
            if self~endStoragesLimitsReached then leave
            if incremental then do
                self~endStoragesAdjustLimits
                self~endStoragesClearUpdatedFlags
            end

            if verbose then do
                say
                say "******************** init - Initialization Backward Grapheme Supplier"
                say
            end
            s~next
        end
    end

-- Initialization

method startStoragesAdjustLimits

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method startStoragesAdjustLimits private
    expose incremental -
           startCodepointIndexes startCodepointIndexesUpdated startCodepointStorageLimit -
           startGraphemeIndexes startGraphemeIndexesUpdated startGraphemeStorageLimit -
           startErrorMessages startErrorMessagesUpdated startErrorStorageLimit -
           verbose trace

    trace value trace

    if verbose then do
        say
        say "startStoragesAdjustLimits:"
    end

    if startGraphemeIndexesUpdated then do
        if startGraphemeIndexes~items > startGraphemeStorageLimit then do
            if verbose then say "    startGraphemeStorageLimit" startGraphemeStorageLimit "-->" startGraphemeIndexes~items
            startGraphemeStorageLimit = startGraphemeIndexes~items
        end
    end
    else if verbose then say "    startGraphemeIndexes was not updated"

    if startCodepointIndexesUpdated then do
        if startCodepointIndexes~items > startCodepointStorageLimit then do
            if verbose then say "    startCodepointStorageLimit" startCodepointStorageLimit "-->" startCodepointIndexes~items
            startCodepointStorageLimit = startCodepointIndexes~items
        end
    end
    else if verbose then say "    startCodepointIndexes was not updated"

    -- In incremental mode, startErrorStorageLimit is boolean-ish, not candidate for adjustment
    if incremental then nop
    else if startErrorMessagesUpdated, startErrorMessages~items > startErrorStorageLimit then startErrorStorageLimit = startErrorMessages~items


-- Initialization

method endStoragesAdjustLimits

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method endStoragesAdjustLimits private
    expose incremental -
           endCodepointIndexes endCodepointIndexesUpdated endCodepointStorageLimit -
           endGraphemeIndexes endGraphemeIndexesUpdated endGraphemeStorageLimit -
           endErrorMessages endErrorMessagesUpdated endErrorStorageLimit -

    end

        if endGraphemeIndexes~items > endGraphemeStorageLimit then do

            endGraphemeStorageLimit = endGraphemeIndexes~items
        end
    end
    else if verbose then say "    endGraphemeIndexes was not updated"

    if endCodepointIndexesUpdated then do
        if endCodepointIndexes~items > endCodepointStorageLimit then do
            if verbose then say "    endCodepointStorageLimit" endCodepointStorageLimit "-->" endCodepointIndexes~items
            endCodepointStorageLimit = endCodepointIndexes~items

    else if verbose then say "    endCodepointIndexes was not updated"

    -- In incremental mode, endErrorStorageLimit is boolean-ish, not candidate for adjustment
    if incremental then nop
    else if endErrorMessagesUpdated, endErrorMessages~items > endErrorStorageLimit then endErrorStorageLimit = endErrorMessages~items


-- Initialization

method startStoragesLimitsReached

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method startStoragesLimitsReached private
    expose incremental -
           startCodepointIndexes startCodepointStorageLimit -
           startGraphemeIndexes startGraphemeStorageLimit -
           startErrorMessages startErrorStorageLimit -
           startCodepointIndexesUpdated startGraphemeIndexesUpdated startErrorMessagesUpdated -
           verbose trace

    trace value trace

    -- If update in progress, allow more updates (typical case: after codepoint storage update, allow error storage update)
    if incremental, startCodepointIndexesUpdated | startGraphemeIndexesUpdated /*| startErrorMessagesUpdated*/ then return .false

    if .nil \== startCodepointIndexes, startCodepointIndexes~items < startCodepointStorageLimit then return .false
    if .nil \== startGraphemeIndexes, startGraphemeIndexes~items < startGraphemeStorageLimit then return .false

    -- An error limit will not trigger further decoding.
    -- if .nil \== startErrorMessages, startErrorMessages~items < startErrorStorageLimit then return .false

    if verbose then do
        say "startStoragesLimitsReached is true:"
        say "    startCodepointIndexesUpdated =" startCodepointIndexesUpdated
        say "    startGraphemeIndexesUpdated =" startGraphemeIndexesUpdated

        if .nil \== startCodepointIndexes, startCodepointIndexes~items >= startCodepointStorageLimit then do
            say "    startCodepointIndexes~items >= startCodepointStorageLimit" "(" startCodepointIndexes~items ">=" startCodepointStorageLimit ")"
        end
        else say "    startCodepointIndexes =" startCodepointIndexes

        if .nil \== startGraphemeIndexes, startGraphemeIndexes~items >= startGraphemeStorageLimit then do
            say "    startGraphemeIndexes~items >= startGraphemeStorageLimit" "(" startGraphemeIndexes~items ">=" startGraphemeStorageLimit ")"
        end
        else say "    startGraphemeIndexes =" startGraphemeIndexes
    end

    return .true


-- Initialization

method endStoragesLimitsReached

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method endStoragesLimitsReached private
    expose incremental -
           endCodepointIndexes endCodepointStorageLimit -
           endGraphemeIndexes endGraphemeStorageLimit -
           endErrorMessages endErrorStorageLimit -
           endCodepointIndexesUpdated endGraphemeIndexesUpdated endErrorMessagesUpdated -
           verbose trace

    trace value trace

    -- If update in progress, allow more updates (typical case: after codepoint storage update, allow error storage update)
    if incremental, endCodepointIndexesUpdated | endGraphemeIndexesUpdated /*| endErrorMessagesUpdated*/ then return .false

    if .nil \== endCodepointIndexes, endCodepointIndexes~items < endCodepointStorageLimit then return .false
    if .nil \== endGraphemeIndexes, endGraphemeIndexes~items < endGraphemeStorageLimit then return .false

    -- An error limit will not trigger further decoding.
    -- if .nil \== endErrorMessages, endErrorMessages~items < endErrorStorageLimit then return .false

    if verbose then do
        say "endStoragesLimitsReached is true:"
        say "    endCodepointIndexesUpdated =" endCodepointIndexesUpdated
        say "    endGraphemeIndexesUpdated =" endGraphemeIndexesUpdated

        if .nil \== endCodepointIndexes, endCodepointIndexes~items >= endCodepointStorageLimit then do
            say "    endCodepointIndexes~items >= endCodepointStorageLimit" "(" endCodepointIndexes~items ">=" endCodepointStorageLimit ")"
        end
        else say "    endCodepointIndexes =" endCodepointIndexes

        if .nil \== endGraphemeIndexes, endGraphemeIndexes~items >= endGraphemeStorageLimit then do
            say "    endGraphemeIndexes~items >= endGraphemeStorageLimit" "(" endGraphemeIndexes~items ">=" endGraphemeStorageLimit ")"
        end
        else say "    endGraphemeIndexes =" endGraphemeIndexes
    end

    return .true


-- Initialization

method startGraphemeIndexesUpdatable

::class "RexxUnicodeStringIndexer"
::method startGraphemeIndexesUpdatable private
    expose incremental -
           startGraphemeIndexes startGraphemeStorageLimit -
           endGraphemeIndexes -
           graphemeCount -
           verbose trace

    trace value trace

    if .nil == startGraphemeIndexes then return .false

    if incremental then do
        -- Adjustable limit
        if self~startStoragesLimitsReached then do
            if verbose then say "startGraphemeIndexesUpdatable is false because startStoragesLimitsReached"
            return .false
        end

        -- Never overlap the end storage
        endItems = 0
        if .nil \== endGraphemeIndexes then endItems = endGraphemeIndexes~items
        if startGraphemeIndexes~items + endItems >= graphemeCount then do
            if verbose then say "startGraphemeIndexesUpdatable is false because would overlap the end storage"
            return .false
        end

        return .true
    end
    else do
        -- Strict limit
        if startGraphemeIndexes~items < startGraphemeStorageLimit then return .true
        if verbose then say "startGraphemeIndexesUpdatable is false because the limit is reached"
        return .false
    end
